scripts.dev:api: mkdir -p dist && wrangler d1 migrations apply forever-forge --local && wrangler pages dev --port 8788 --binding DEV_MAIL_OUTBOX=1 --live-reload=false dist
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && vite build && node scripts/check-launch.mjs
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/check-launch.mjs --strict && wrangler pages deploy dist
